name: ResolveIQ synthetic support evaluation
note: The runner expands missing datasets, but this checked-in file includes representative seed cases for review.

cases.input_text: Can I get a refund for an unopened item delivered yesterday?
cases.reference_answer: Refunds are allowed within the policy window when evidence supports the request.

cases.input_text: My delayed order has not moved in tracking for six business days.
cases.reference_answer: Check tracking and offer policy-backed next steps for stalled shipments.

cases.input_text: I want to cancel my subscription before the next billing date.
cases.reference_answer: Explain cancellation steps without promising unsupported refunds.

cases.input_text: My account was hacked and the card may be stolen.
cases.reference_answer: Escalate account takeover and fraud concerns.

cases.input_text: I was double charged and will file a chargeback.
